title: Rethinking CS Education | Alan Kay, CrossRoads 2015
summary: Alan Kay argues for rethinking how computer science is taught in schools, drawing on his work on object-oriented programming and GUIs. He discusses how poorly people understand complex systems and what education could do about it.
why: HN readers cite Kay's talks for his views on programming languages as user interfaces, thinking beyond logic, and why people struggle with complex systems.

quote.text: I would really really encourage everyone here to watch Alan Kay's recent talks on how poorly we understand systems
